import json
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest,write_json
out=Path("artifacts/engine-integration-001/temporal-integration-001")
rows=[]
for case,expected in (("D01-gripper-sign","accepted"),("D05-recurrent-carry","rejected")):
 p=out/(case+"-evaluation.json")
 result=json.loads(p.read_bytes())
 codes=sorted({r["code"] for r in result["reasons"]})
 assert result["decision"]==expected
 if case.startswith("D05"): assert "progress_lost" in codes
 rows.append({"case":case,"decision":result["decision"],"reason_codes":codes,"evaluation_wall_s":result["evaluation_wall_s"],"retained_evaluation_sha256":file_digest(p)})
report={"records":rows,"actual_evaluation_command":"efcc9db2cff74f69a2b5a20e170f4137","initial_command_status":"nonzero_after_both_evaluations_completed_and_were_written","initial_summary_error":"Read reason_codes instead of the evaluator reasons[].code field; actual decision files are unchanged and were not re-evaluated.","new_simulator_executions":0,"scope":"Summary of current evaluator readbacks on the original actual stores; nested evaluation costs belong to the original command"}
write_json(out/"finite-readback.json",report)
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
